title: 💀 KILL PRIDE BEFORE IT KILLS YOUR PURPOSE.
paragraphs: 💀 KILL PRIDE BEFORE IT KILLS YOUR PURPOSE.
Your calling rises when your ego dies. 📉📈
We live in a world that tells you to "hype yourself up," "protect your brand," and "secure the bag." But in the Kingdom, the way up is down.
God cannot fill a vessel that is already full of you.

As long as you are worried about your reputation, your comfort, and your credit, you are capping your own potential. A true Gospel Warrior knows that the mission isn't about becoming famous; it's about being faithful.
You have to bury your need for validation so your purpose can finally breathe. The spotlight is too small for both you and Jesus. Step out of it, and watch what He does.
"He must become greater; I must become less." — John 3:30 (NIV)
Your Move: Type "LESS OF ME" if you are ready to get out of God's way today! 🙏⬇️
